I replied to Pree in your DM (DV04CAL0001) to confirm her new dock. From now on, Bay 26 is the dock she uses for Marrow Agrisupply pickups on the Wicklow project.

The knowledge brain had already saved her message automatically, and searching it brings that fact back. It's the only note it has on this, so no older dock needed replacing.

One concern: the saved fact is marked "world" visibility, not private to her. The setup says DM facts should only show to the member who sent them. I left the record as it is. I told Pree I'll only bring this up in conversations with her, and I'll keep it out of anyone else's conversations and out of channels.
